summary.text: Daniel Jones is the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 24, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Kevin Raper (R).
He advanced from the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed and was also the Democratic nominee for the seat in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Jones advanced from the Democratic primary for District 24 unopposed on August 6, 2020, and lost the November 3, 2020 general election to incumbent Mark Hall, 23.6 percent to 76.4 percent.
Ballotpedia lists him as advancing unopposed from the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary for the same seat.
